candidate.answerReason: All 50 students have equal selection chances. Selecting 5 students gives each individual's inclusion probability as 5/50 = 1/10.

methods.label: Use equal selection chances
methods.explanation: Drawing lots gives all 50 students the same chance of selection. Since 5 students are selected, each student's probability is the fraction of the group selected: \(5\div50=1/10\).
methods.levelReason: Equal selection chances and elementary fraction reduction suffice at grade-7 level. The individual-selection-probability criterion of cnm_h124 fits without requiring advanced probability.
